name: A Barbarian's Spite flings the caster back after its third Berserker Throw (#12466)
contract: Spite 707584 reads: unleash 3 Berserker Throws at your target and then fling yourself back a great distance.
Its native leap (effect 0) is removed at load, and aura_ascension_barbarian_volley throws every 200 ms.
After the third throw it must send the leap: LEAP_BACK MiscValue 250 and BasePoints 74 + DieSides 1.
MotionMaster::MoveJumpTo returns at once for players, so the old script never moved the Barbarian.
A caster facing east (o 0) is sent west: direction cosine -1, sine 0, speeds 25 and 7.5 (Z negated).
This observes the trajectory instruction; client landing and input remain unverified.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the Barbarian is sent back, away from the target it faces
the direction has no sideways component
the great distance keeps the authored horizontal speed
the leap keeps the authored vertical speed
